translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: “Winjuru wechena, un joma riek;
chiknauru itu, un joma osomo.
Nikech it temo weche
mana kaka lep bilo chiemo.
Wayieruru kendwa gima nikare;
wapuonjreuru kaachiel kuom gima ber.
“Ayub wacho ni, ‘Aonge ketho,
to Nyasaye otamore timona maber.
Kata obedo ni an kare,
to pod ikwana mana ni an ja-miriambo;
kata obedo ni aonge ketho,
to asere mare osechwoya,
moweya gi adhola ma ok thiedhre!’
To en ngʼa machalo gi Ayub;
mamodho ajara kaka pi?
En e achiel gi joma timbegi richo;
kendo oriwore gi joricho.
Nikech osebedo kowacho ni, ‘Onge ohala ma dhano yudo,
ka otemo matek mondo otim gima ber ne Nyasaye!’
“Omiyo lingʼuru uwinja, un joma nigi winjo.
Nyasaye ok nyal timo gima rach kata dichiel,
Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ok tim gima ok owinjore.
Ochulo dhano kaluwore gi timbene
okelone mana gima owinjore gi timbene.
En gima kwero mondo Nyasaye otim gima ok owinjore;
kendo mondo Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ongʼad bura ma ok nikare.
En ngʼa mane okete jarit piny?
En ngʼa mane oketo piny duto e bwo tekone?
Ka dabed ni Nyasaye
ogolo muche makelo ngima kuom dhano,
to ji duto ditho dichiel
kendo dhano didogi e lowo.
“Ka un gi winjo adier to winjuru wachni;
kendo chikuru itu ne gima awacho.
Ngʼama ochayo adiera bende nyalo rito loch adier?
Ere gimomiyo iketo bura kuom ngʼama ja-ratiro kendo Jal Maratego?
Donge Nyasaye ema wacho ne ruodhi ni, ‘Un joma nono,’
kendo owacho ne jo-mwandu ni, ‘Timbeu richo,’
Nyasaye ok odewo kata mana wangʼ ruodhi
kendo ok otim maber ne jo-mwandu to jochan to oweyo,
nikech gin duto gin chwech lwete?
Joma roteke tho apoya e dier otieno;
inegogi mi gilal nono,
kendo igologi e dier ji, to ok gi lwet dhano.
“Wangʼe osiko karango timbe ji;
oneno okangʼ kokangʼ ma gigoyo.
Onge kama otimo mudho
kata kama olil gi tipo ma joricho nyalo pondoe.
Onge gima ochuno ni Nyasaye nyaka non dhano amingʼa
eka okelgi e nyime mondo oyalgi.
Oketho telo mar joma roteke ma ok oyalogi
kendo oketo joma moko e telo kargi.
Nikech ongʼeyo timbegi
oloko loch mag-gi gotieno mi otiekgi chuth.
Okumo joricho e lela
nikech timbegi maricho kama ji duto nyalo nenogie,
nikech negilokore giweyo luwe
kendo ne ok gidewo yorene kata achiel.
Negimiyo ywak joma odhier ochopo malo e nyime,
mine owinjo ywak jochan.
Kata ka nenore ni olingʼ, to en ngʼa ma dingʼadne bura?
Koso kopando wangʼe, to en ngʼa ma dinene?
To kata kamano en ema orito ogendini
mondo kik gibed e bwo loch ngʼat mokia Nyasaye,
kendo machiko ni ji obadho.
“Ka dipo ngʼato nyalo wachone Nyasaye ni,
‘Aseketho to ok anachak atimne ngʼato marach.
Puonja mondo ane gik mopondona;
kapo asetimo gimoro marach,
to ok abi achak atim kamano kendo!’
Ere kaka idwaro ni Nyasaye otimni maber,
to in to idagi lokori?
In ema nyaka ingʼad e pachi iwuon,
ok an, omiyo koro nyisane gima ingʼeyo.
“Joma nigi winjo nyiso pachgi
joma riek mawinja wachona ni,
‘Ayub osewuoyo maonge rieko;
osewacho weche ma ok oparo maber.’
Yaye, mad med ameda temo Ayub nyaka giko
nikech aduokane chalo aduoka ngʼama timbene richo.
Omedo dhi nyime gi timo richo
koyanyo Nyasaye e nyim ogandane,
kendo omedo wuoyo marach kuom Nyasaye.”
